The TypeSpec Assessment Assistant is currently in preview. Its goal is to help service developers build confidence earlier in the TypeSpec authoring workflow by providing contextual analysis, risk identification, and guidance on potential downstream impacts.

This report is intended as a review reference and learning aid only. It does not replace official ARM API, Azure API Stewardship, Azure Breaking Change reviews, and should not be treated as authoritative review feedback or approval for specification changes. ScenarioConfigurations.executeThe normalized SDK method contract changes directly.
Affected intents (1)
Model scenario actions as Location-polled long-running operations
Direct method change

Target normalized SDK method: Microsoft.Chaos.ScenarioConfigurations.execute

Contract areaBeforeAfter
SDK methodMethod kindScenarioConfigurations.execute becomes a long-running operation. Callers must wait for final completion rather than treating the initial response as completion.
basic
lro
SDK methodLong-running behaviorScenarioConfigurations.execute now requires status polling and a final-result request. Callers must follow this completion process instead of treating the initial execution response as final.
none
{
  "finalStateVia": "location",
  "logicalResult": "Microsoft.Chaos.ScenarioRun",
  "pollingStep": "model",
  "finalStep": "finalOperationLink",
  "statusMonitorStep": "nextOperationLink"
}
SDK methodReturn type (body output)
void
ScenarioRun
Why this is breaking:
  • ScenarioConfigurations.execute becomes a long-running operation. Callers must wait for final completion rather than treating the initial response as completion.
  • ScenarioConfigurations.execute now produces ScenarioRun after long-running completion instead of no result. Code tied to its previous no-result completion contract must adapt; callers that discard results are less affected.
  • ScenarioConfigurations.execute now requires status polling and a final-result request. Callers must follow this completion process instead of treating the initial execution response as final.

Language-neutral TCGC evidence is shown; generated language signatures are not fabricated.

specification/chaos/resource-manager/Microsoft.Chaos/Chaos/scenarioRun.models.tsp
 import "./scenario.models.tsp";
 
 using TypeSpec.Rest;
+using TypeSpec.Http;
 using Azure.ResourceManager;
 using Azure.Core;
 using Azure.Core.Traits;
 
 namespace Microsoft.Chaos;
 
+/**
+ * Indicates the scenario run is still in progress. Clients polling via the
+ * Location header should continue polling until a 200 response is returned.
+ * The body reflects the current run state at the time of the poll.
+ */
+model ScenarioRunInProgressResponse {
+  ...AcceptedResponse;
+
+  /**
+   * The URL where the status of the long-running operation can be polled.
+   */
+  @header("Location")
+  location: url;
+
+  /**
+   * The number of seconds the client should wait before polling again.
+   */
+  @minValue(0)
+  @maxValue(2147483647)
+  @header("Retry-After")
+  retryAfter?: int32;
+
+  /**
+   * The current scenario run state at the time of the poll.
+   */
+  @bodyRoot body: ScenarioRun;
+}
+
 /**
  * Model that represents the scenario run.
  */
